title: diagnostics.list input
description: List the diagnostics currently shown in the Error List: errors, warnings and messages, each with its file, line, column, code and message, and its source (the last build, the live analysis, or both). Optionally filter by severity and source.

severity.description: Only return diagnostics of this severity. Omit to return all. Names follow the Visual Studio Error List (Errors, Warnings, Messages).

source.description: Only return diagnostics from this source: build (the last build's, including those the live analysis reports too) or live (the language server's and the solution load's, including those the build reports too). Omit to return all.
